advice.CARBON_MONOXIDE: Leave the home and call emergency services if the detection is confirmed.
advice.DOOR_OPEN: Check whether the door is still open and close it if needed.
advice.FALL_DETECTION: Check promptly that the resident is all right. The signal may indicate a possible fall; confirm the situation in person or by calling.
advice.INACTIVITY: No detected movement does not by itself confirm a problem. Send {{residentName}} a call request on their screen to check that they are all right. If there is no answer and you remain concerned, ask someone to check in person.
advice.LOW_BATTERY: Plan to replace the sensor battery.
advice.MEDICATION_MISSED: Check whether the dose was taken before giving another. If uncertain, follow the healthcare professional’s instructions.
advice.SENSOR_OFFLINE: Élise is no longer receiving data from this sensor. Check its power and connection; some conclusions remain suspended.
advice.SMOKE: If smoke is present, get to safety and call emergency services.
advice.SOS: Contact the resident or emergency services as appropriate.
advice.SYSTEM: Check the sensors and their connection. While data is insufficient, Élise cannot reliably assess situations that depend on them.
advice.TEMPERATURE: Check the resident’s comfort and the heating or ventilation.
advice.UNUSUAL_ACTIVITY: Check the detection times in the timeline and whether this activity matches the usual nighttime pattern.
advice.WATER_LEAK: Check the affected area and turn off the water if needed.
advice.default: Review the recorded facts and times, then confirm the situation before closing it.

heiman-fall-detection.advice: Install it indoors only and follow the height and orientation in the manual. Choose an unobstructed position covering the resident’s living area; the product sheet advertises 4 × 4 m on a wall and 4 × 5 m on the ceiling. Élise supports caregiver vigilance; fall detection does not replace telecare or a human check-in.
features: Fall states reported over Zigbee: normal, fall warning or fall alarm
Wall or ceiling mounting, for indoor use only
Advertised range: 4 × 4 m on a wall or 4 × 5 m on the ceiling
heiman-fall-detection.name: Zigbee Fall Detection Sensor
placement: Install it indoors only and follow the height and orientation in the manual.
Choose an unobstructed position covering the resident’s living area; the product sheet advertises 4 × 4 m on a wall and 4 × 5 m on the ceiling.
Élise supports caregiver vigilance; fall detection does not replace telecare or a human check-in.
preparation: The retailer lists HS2FD-E; Zigbee2MQTT documents variant HS2FD-EF1-3.0. Ask the seller to confirm the exact reference before buying.
Connect the sensor to a 5 V / 2 A power supply near the Élise hub.
In Élise OS, choose “Install this sensor” and then Zigbee. Put the sensor in pairing mode using its manual; no Heiman hub or account is required.
After installation, verify a fall alert using the manufacturer’s test mode. This model has not yet been physically tested with Élise.

heiman-smoke-detector.advice: Mount it in the location and orientation required by the manual and applicable housing rules. Keep the detector unobstructed and accessible for testing; do not paint or cover it.
features: Photoelectric smoke detection and built-in siren ≥ 85 dB at 3 m
Zigbee2MQTT exposes smoke, test and battery (0–100%) states; Élise receives smoke and battery level
EN 14604 certification listed by the retailer
heiman-smoke-detector.name: Smart Zigbee smoke detector
placement: Mount it in the location and orientation required by the manual and applicable housing rules.
Keep the detector unobstructed and accessible for testing; do not paint or cover it.
preparation: Check the HS1SA-E reference: standalone and Z-Wave Heiman variants are not compatible with Élise Zigbee setup.
Install a CR123A battery, then bring the detector near the Élise hub.
In Élise OS, choose “Install this sensor” and then Zigbee. Use a paper clip to hold the side button for more than 2 seconds until the LED flashes rapidly.
It joins Élise OS over Zigbee via Zigbee2MQTT; no Heiman account, app or hub is required.
Keep the detector awake by pressing its button every 2 seconds until pairing is complete.

After installation, test the siren as described in the manual and check the detector and battery status in Élise. Zigbee2MQTT reports that some firmware versions can send repeated false smoke states; monitor it after pairing.
The detector has its own local siren. Élise notifications provide additional awareness and have not yet been validated on physical hardware.

tuya-bed-pressure-strip.advice: Slide the strip under the mattress, where the manual recommends and where it can detect a person lying down. Before relying on bedtime and wake-up times, check several times in Élise that the sensor changes to “Occupied” when someone lies down and “Unoccupied” when they get up. It reports detected occupancy, not sleep quality or sleep stages.
features: Flexible pressure strip to place under the mattress
Battery, illuminance, sensitivity and timing settings exposed by Zigbee2MQTT
tuya-bed-pressure-strip.name: Bed occupancy pressure strip
placement: Slide the strip under the mattress, where the manual recommends and where it can detect a person lying down.
Before relying on bedtime and wake-up times, check several times in Élise that the sensor changes to “Occupied” when someone lies down and “Unoccupied” when they get up.
It reports detected occupancy, not sleep quality or sleep stages.
tuya-bed-pressure-strip.power: Replaceable batteries · type and runtime to confirm for this seller reference
preparation: Start Zigbee pairing from Élise OS, then enable pairing mode on the sensor as described in its manual. The Zigbee2MQTT-recognized model needs no Smart Life/Tuya account or Tuya hub.

When detected, verify the model is “TS0601_bed_presence_sensor” (Tuya) and an occupancy function appears. ManoMano does not state the Zigbee model code for this listing; if another model appears, do not assign it to a bed until checked.
